title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, September 22 2026
summary:
Main
Bulkers
Bulker S&P values held broadly stable across the board this week, with recent Panamax and Ultramaxresale activity trading at modest premiums. Panamax BW Japan (81,600 DWT, May 2019, Tsuneishi Cebu) sold to Great Eastern Shipping for USD 38.25 mil, VV Value USD 36.56 mil. Ultramax Hull 297 (63,500 DWT, Jan 2027, Jiangsu Haitong) sold to an undisclosed buyer for USD 39.0 mil, VV Value USD 37.52 mil.
